subject: Charformer JAX port — kickoff
body:
Hi Bruno,

Kicking off the Charformer effort. Our open-source release is the Mesh-TensorFlow reference implementation of gradient-based subword tokenization — layers that plug into the T5 codebase — and the README has promised a JAX/FLAX implementation "later" for long enough that it's become a running joke. More importantly, tokenizer-free models are back on the roadmap: the multilingual quality team wants GBST for scripts where our current subword vocab is embarrassing.

Goals for Feb 9 – May 4: (1) JAX/FLAX GBST layer with parity against the Mesh-TF reference on a small config, (2) integration into our internal trainer, (3) a base-size training run demonstrating quality on the multilingual eval. Scaled sweeps come in Q3 with real budget.

Bruno — staffing and the budget conversation with Finance are the first blockers. Can you take both?

Priya
